THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
RIBBONS & LINES
013
11 / Ribbon Daydream
Close-up beauty portrait with two braids, red patterned
ribbon bows, soft freckles and a delicate cream floral garment.
The subtle smile and diffused daylight establish a nostalgic
romantic mood.
12 / Brown Study
Fitted brown long-sleeve top, dark patterned mini skirt,
narrow belt and loose blonde waves with bangs. A neutral gray
backdrop gives the silhouette and garment textures prominence.
